summary: The proposed patch addresses a regression risk but lacks thorough documentation and may introduce a performance regression.

issues.description: The change may break existing behavior when loading fixtures with explicit pk values.
The approach of checking for raw and force_insert may be brittle and not cover all edge cases.
The change may introduce a performance regression due to the additional checks.
The patch lacks thorough documentation and comments to explain the reasoning behind the change.
The patch does not follow the project convention of using blank lines to separate logical sections of code.
